caption: The drawing features the façade of a mission-style building rendered in grayscale. The structure has a symmetrical design with a central arched doorway framed by columns and topped with a semicircular window above the door. On each side of the doorway, there are rectangular alcoves, each containing a small platform, flanked by decorative pilasters and topped by rounded, ornate trim. Above the central doorway is an elevated rectangular niche and additional architectural detailing including a triangular decorative element at the roof peak. Two urn-shaped ornaments are positioned above the doorway and below the roof. The composition is centered on the page, and beneath the illustration, there is a ribbon/banner design containing the text "1777 mision santa clara" in a handwritten style. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the architectural drawing and the text below it.
title: Mision Santa Clara
